purpose: Record immutable external-system identities and comparison eligibility for dynamic BFS evidence.

accepted_same_semantics.scope: directed unweighted exact BFS under batched sliding-window insertions and deletions
accepted_same_semantics.notes: Native incremental-maintenance research-system baseline; existing result is a separate hosted-CI campaign.

accepted_same_semantics.scope: directed unweighted exact BFS under batched sliding-window insertions and deletions
accepted_same_semantics.timing_contract: native C++ graph mutation plus DynBFS.updateBatch; independent full BFS verification excluded from timing
accepted_same_semantics.notes: Native C++ same-machine repeated campaign after exact allocation-free merged traversal, reusable BFS workspaces, flat update-key tables, and a measured 16,384-entry minimum before percentage-triggered automatic global delta maintenance. All repetitions require exact correctness and nontrivial final reachability before timing is accepted.

accepted_secondary_system_baselines.scope: dynamic structural updates plus Graphalytics BFS over an updated snapshot
accepted_secondary_system_baselines.notes: Serious VLDB 2021 dynamic-graph system, but its public evaluation contract does not maintain BFS incrementally after every update batch. Use only for a separately labelled snapshot/structural comparison.

accepted_secondary_system_baselines.scope: dynamic graph updates with BFS over acquired snapshots
accepted_secondary_system_baselines.notes: Strong graph-streaming research system, but the public artifact exposes snapshot BFS rather than incremental BFS-state maintenance and relies on legacy Cilk Plus tooling.

rejected_for_same_semantics_table.reason: Dynamic storage system with graph kernels, but no public RisGraph-like exact incremental BFS maintenance contract; also depends on OpenCilk/Tapir-specific build tooling.

rejected_for_same_semantics_table.system: LiveGraph / GraphOne / STINGER via GFE Driver
rejected_for_same_semantics_table.reason: Credible structural dynamic graph systems, but GFE separates update experiments from Graphalytics BFS kernels instead of restoring BFS after each identical batch.

claim_rule: Only systems in accepted_same_semantics may appear in the main dynamic-BFS latency evidence. Same-machine paired ratios may be reported for a campaign; results from different hosted runners must not be combined into a cross-system ranking. Hosted-CI measurements remain engineering evidence, not universal or publication-grade superiority claims.
